senses.gloss:
ओजस् ओजस्, i. e. वज् + अस्,
 I. n.
 1. Strength, Matsyop. 2.
 2. Light, splendour, Man. 12, 18.
 II. ओजसा (instr.), adv. Powerfully, Chr. 291, 4 = Rigv. i. 85, 4; courageously, Rām. 3, 53, 22.
 --Comp.
 --Cf. Lat. augus in augus + tus, and αὐγή, -αὐγες in ἀνταυγής, ές.
ओजस्विन् ओजस् + विन्, adj., f. नी, Strong, MBh. 14, 100.
